have benefited. Anthropic routed 47% of its sales to customers in 2025 through those two cloud partners, according to the report. Sales through these two partners accounted for $2.16B, and Anthropic paid about $351M, or about 16 cents per dollar, in distribution fees back to these cloud partners in 2025.
In return, both Amazon and Google have heavily invested in Anthropic. Sales through those partners have surged every year, from 11% of revenue in 2023 to 32% in 2024 to nearly 50% in 2025.
In addition, two unnamed customers accounted for 12% of Anthropic's total revenue in 2025.
